external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and receives a token containing a staff id and group membership.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The HR system that supplies colleague and group-membership changes to the identity broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: An identity provider operated by the franchise colleagues' organization that vouches for them to the broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

external_entities.name: store
external_entities.description: A store against which the store admin console can change prices and void transactions.
external_entities.source_excerpt: a store-manager token works against every store.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, validates or accepts franchise sign-ins, supplies public signing material, pulls HR changes, and writes audit records.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: application
processes.description: An application that accepts the broker-issued token and decides what a colleague may do from the groups in it.
processes.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application on the corporate network that allows a holder of a store-manager token to change prices and void transactions.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications. It also runs on the corporate network.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records, whether it covers the franchise route, or whether the directory or the log are encrypted where they sit.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.
data_flows.data_description: Colleague sign-in data.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues an application a token for a colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying a staff id and group membership.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues the store admin console a token for a colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying a staff id and group membership.

data_flows.name: fetch public half
data_flows.description: Applications fetch the public half of the broker's signing key from the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: The public half of the token-signing key.

data_flows.name: change prices and void transactions
data_flows.description: The store admin console changes prices and voids transactions at stores when the token contains the store-manager group.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.
data_flows.authentication: The store-manager group in the token
data_flows.data_description: Price changes and transaction voids.

data_flows.name: supply changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls colleague and group-membership changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night, and that is also how leavers stop being colleagues.
data_flows.data_description: Colleague and group-membership changes.

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains its directory with colleagues and their groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.data_description: Colleague records and group memberships.

data_flows.name: keep signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps its signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.data_description: The token-signing key.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in records; the exact contents are unknown.

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues and the broker accepts that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: It has not been written down which colleagues that provider is allowed to vouch for.
data_flows.data_description: A franchise colleague's federated sign-in assertion.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.
